en.headline: Design Ah! interactive exhibition continues at M+ through January
en.dek: The family-friendly show exploring everyday design through 21 play stations remains open at the Main Hall Gallery in West Kowloon until 10 January 2027.
body: M+ is presenting Design Ah! Experience the Wonder of Everyday Design, an interactive exhibition that invites visitors to examine ordinary objects and daily actions through hands-on games and installations.

The show features 21 stations organised around ten everyday actions, some of which draw on Hong Kong’s visual environment and culinary traditions. It is based on the Japanese children’s educational programme Design Ah! neo and was produced by NHK Educational Corporation, NHK Promotion Inc. and TOKYO NODE.

Visitors are encouraged to look closely, try things out and learn through play. The exhibition is on view in the Main Hall Gallery on the ground floor from 27 June 2026 to 10 January 2027. Tickets are available through the museum’s website; M+ Members enjoy unlimited admission.

zh.headline: M+《設計啊！》互動展持續至明年一月
zh.dek: 以日常設計為題的親子互動展覽於西九文化區M+主展廳舉行，設21個體驗站，展期至2027年1月10日。
body: M+正舉行《設計啊！感受日常設計之奇妙》互動展覽，透過動手遊戲及裝置，邀請觀眾重新審視日常物件與行為。
展覽設21個體驗站，圍繞十項日常動作展開，部分內容呼應香港視覺環境及飲食傳統。展覽概念源自日本兒童教育節目《Design Ah! neo》，由NHK教育公司、NHK推廣公司及TOKYO NODE製作。
觀眾可透過觀察、嘗試及遊戲學習。展覽於主展廳地下層舉行，展期由2026年6月27日至2027年1月10日。門票可於博物館網站購買，M+會員可無限次入場。
